mentions.name: New theory of management book
mentions.description: A book-in-progress presenting a new theory of management centered on being a human, inspiring leader instead of relying on codified systems like EOS, MBAs, and KPI-driven management. The author is writing up notes on how human, engaged leadership turns around dysfunctional teams and lifts productivity, and is considering publishing it as small blog tidbits or social media videos while working out the theory's name and a collaborator/observer to document their methods.
mentions.problem: The author argues management has been overcomplicated and dehumanized by people trying to codify it (MBAs, systems like EOS, KPIs), which they see as the main cause of the productivity crisis and of people quitting to become more productive without a boss.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a new theory of management. I was explaining leadership to someone and they said I should write a book about it.
